posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md:
On pages 176 & 177, in the illustrations are drawn in such a way that the *undiffracted* light that goes through the H1 will also hit part of the H2 hologram. I cannot understand how this could work because where the undiffracted light hits the H2, a secondary interference pattern would be created. The drawings are made such that the undiffracted light cannot possibly be blocked off to prevent hitting the H2.

Am I mistaking here?

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
No, you're right. I think though that the drawing is meant to be representative and not necessarily a schematic to be taken literally.

The distances and angles used will depend on the equipment you have and I know he mentions these things at several points in the book.
